units.source_text: 我想起莱蒙特说过，在圣诞节那天，精灵们回到了人世间的家。

en.t: I remembered Lamont saying that on Christmas Day, the spirits returned to their homes in the human world.

units.source_text: 他叹息精灵们的寂寞，因为他们的遗属认为：

en.t: He lamented the loneliness of the spirits, because their surviving families believed this:

units.source_text: 人一旦作古，灵魂也会跟着毁灭。

en.t: Once a person died, the soul would perish along with them.

units.source_text: 从你去世之后，如同在盂兰盆会上祭祀你的精灵时一样，

en.t: Since your death, just as when your spirit is honored at the Bon Festival,

units.source_text: 我一次也不曾迎接过你的精灵归来。

en.t: I have not once welcomed your spirit back.
